libraries.name: Three.js
libraries.author: Three.js contributors
libraries.loading: Bundled by Vite as a lazy chunk; Draco, meshopt and Basis/KTX2 codecs from the pinned distribution load with a GLB. WebGL2 required.

libraries.name: ONNX Runtime Web
libraries.author: ONNX Runtime contributors
libraries.loading: Loaded on demand inside a browser worker, WASM CPU execution with one thread.

libraries.name: Draco
libraries.author: Google Draco contributors
libraries.loading: On demand for GLB using KHR_draco_mesh_compression.

libraries.name: meshoptimizer
libraries.author: Arseny Kapoulkine and contributors
libraries.loading: On demand for GLB using EXT_meshopt_compression or KHR_meshopt_compression.

libraries.name: Basis Universal
libraries.author: Binomial and contributors
libraries.loading: On demand for local KTX2 textures.

models.name: U²-NetP salient-object background cutout
models.author: Xuebin Qin et al.; mirror maintained by Edge Tools (isword14)
models.limitation: Generic salient-object detection; not garment-specific, verify the cutout before saving.
models.loading: Fetched and SHA-256 verified only after the user explicitly clicks on-device cutout; cached locally.

proceduralTextures.author: PhotoLens project
proceduralTextures.purpose: Tileable procedural albedo, canvas normal and roughness maps.
